name: Fear Reality
summary:
Fear Reality is a multiplayer VR horror game where every round can be different. Explore creepy environments, complete tasks, mess around with your friends, and try to survive the monsters lurking around the map.

Fear Reality has  horror with different monsters and stuff to explore. Explore places like abandoned labs and more and more as the game continues to grow.

With different monsters such as Teethling, Splitface,Mimic and more, you never know what you're going to run into.
